jobs.occupation: Technology Transfer & Partnership Manager – Applied Geodata & Research Solutions (Full-Time / m/f/d) (Master of Business Administration)
jobs.description:
Location: Germany (Hybrid / Remote options available) 

Contract Type: Full-Time Employment (Permanent / Dual Master Track available) 

Target Group: Business Development Managers, Technology Transfer Specialists, Marketing & Sales Talents, Master’s Graduates, Opportunity Card (Chancenkarte) Holders 

About Project Iris 

Project Iris is an applied research initiative dedicated to automated spatial data analysis, land registry intelligence, sustainable infrastructure mapping, and open-source resilience modeling. 

To ensure long-term independence and funding for non-profit research, Project Iris works with an established commercial transfer network (including RE-Managers GmbH). Through this framework, proprietary data algorithms, geospatial scoring models, and automation tools are licensed and deployed across real-world commercial sectors (e.g., real estate, institutional investments, infrastructure providers, and SME enterprise solutions). 

Your Focus & Responsibilities 

- Research Transfer & Commercialization: Identify commercial use cases for our geospatial and resilience data models, translating scientific capabilities into clear value propositions for enterprise clients and institutional partners. 
- B2B Outreach & Pipeline Management: Lead proactive outreach campaigns targeting potential data partners, municipalities, enterprise clients, and specialized service providers using modern CRM and automation tools (e.g., Odoo ERP, automated email workflows). 
- Partner Onboarding & Account Management: Manage communication with corporate partners, coordinate pilot testing phases, and gather operational market feedback to help researchers refine underlying data models. 
- Marketing & Value Proposition Communication: Create structured presentation decks, use-case briefs, and digital campaign materials to position our data products in commercial and public markets. 
- Funding & Grant Alignment: Support the interface between commercial data licensing and applied research funding projects. 

What We Are Looking For 

- Educational Background: Degree in Business Administration, Technology Management, International Business, Marketing, Geoinformatics, Economics, or a related field. 
- Professional Competencies: 
- Strong interest in technology, spatial data, AI platforms, or digital business models. 
- Experience with or quick adoption of digital outreach tools, CRM systems (e.g., Odoo), and structured email communication. 
- High level of communication clarity, commercial acumen, and consultative relationship-building skills. 
- Mindset: Proactive, structured, and comfortable working at the intersection of non-profit research and commercial markets. 
- Eligibility: Open to local and international applicants currently in Germany (e.g., Chancenkarte / Opportunity Card, Job-Seeker Visa, EU Work Permit). 
- Languages: Excellent working proficiency in English (required); good command of German is a strong advantage for the DACH market. 

What We Offer 

- Full-Time Permanent Position: Long-term career security with direct exposure to executive management and commercial leadership. 
- Dual Master / Trainee Track Available: We support continuous academic development through fully sponsored Master Trainee and Dual Master tracks. 
- Accommodation & Onboarding Support: Concrete assistance with local housing search, official registration, and structured onboarding. 
- Visa & Relocation Assistance: Comprehensive employer backing for German Opportunity Card conversions and residence permit processes. 
- Direct Business Impact: Drive the commercial sustainability of high-impact research projects without corporate bureaucracy. 

How to Apply 

Send your CV, references, and your earliest possible start date to: 

E-Mail: jobs@iris-institut.de  

(Subject: Application – Technology Transfer & Partnership Manager)

jobs.occupation: Software Engineer – Applied AI, Geodata Systems & Data Transfer (Full-Time / m/f/d) (Geoinformatiker/in)
jobs.description:
Location: Germany (Hybrid / Remote options available) 

Contract Type: Full-Time Employment (Permanent) 

Target Group: Software Engineers, Data Engineers, Full-Stack Developers, Opportunity Card (Chancenkarte) Holders, and Master’s Graduates 

About Project Iris 

Project Iris is an applied research and technology initiative dedicated to automated spatial data analysis, cadastre intelligence, infrastructure mapping, and open-source data modeling. 

Together with our commercial transfer network (including RE-Managers GmbH), we bridge the gap between academic data science, resilience research, and practical real-world application. Complex geospatial and resilience data models are deployed into active enterprise environments, stakeholder portals, and infrastructure tools. The resulting real-world usage and performance metrics are continuously validated and fed back into our open research models. 

In this role, you turn algorithmic frameworks and spatial datasets into robust, production-ready digital architectures. 

Your Focus & Responsibilities 

- Geospatial & Core Data Modeling: Develop and refine automated pipelines for spatial datasets, open-source cadastre records, and environmental scoring algorithms using Python. 
- AI-Assisted Full-Stack Integration: Transform algorithmic logic into high-performance FastAPI backends and connect them with modern React/Next.js frontends (leveraging cutting-edge tools such as v0.dev, Cursor, and Windsurf). 
- Applied Transfer & Enterprise Workflows: Implement real-world pilot applications by connecting data models to practical workflows (e.g., automated property screening, municipal portals, and ERP/Odoo interface connections for infrastructure). 
- Multi-Tenant Architecture & Cloud Deployment: Package services into robust Docker multi-container environments and deploy them on secure European/Swiss server infrastructure (Infomaniak VPS) with strict Row-Level Security (RLS) and data privacy standards. 
- Continuous Feedback Architecture: Establish data pipelines that capture operational feedback from commercial deployments to refine and advance the research models. 

What We Are Looking For 

- Technical Background: Degree in Computer Science, Geoinformatics, Software Engineering, Data Science, or equivalent practical industry experience. 
- Core Technical Skills: 
- Solid programming foundation in Python (FastAPI, Pandas, data handling) and/or modern Web technologies (TypeScript, React, Next.js). 
- Working knowledge of relational databases (PostgreSQL) and containerization (Docker / Docker Compose). 
- Practical experience or strong interest in AI-assisted development tools (Cursor, v0.dev, LLM APIs). 
- Mindset: Strong analytical curiosity, proactive problem-solving attitude, and a clean-code engineering approach. 
- Eligibility: Open to local applicants and international candidates currently in Germany (e.g., Chancenkarte / Opportunity Card, Job-Seeker Visa, or EU Work Permit). 
- Languages: Professional working proficiency in English (required); German language skills are a plus. 

What We Offer 

- Full-Time Permanent Employment: Long-term career stability with clear growth trajectories into Senior Engineering or Technical Leadership roles. 
- Dual Master / Trainee Track Available: For candidates looking to combine full-time practice with further academic credentials, we offer tailored Master Trainee tracks including academic coordination and complete tuition support. 
- Accommodation & Onboarding Package: Structured assistance with local accommodation, official registration, and comprehensive onboarding support. 
- Visa & Administrative Backing: Dedicated employer support for Opportunity Card conversions and German residence/work permit applications. 
- Modern AI-First Work Environment: Work in a high-efficiency environment where repetitive boilerplate code is automated, allowing you to focus on high-value architecture, data logic, and deployment. 
- Direct Mentorship: Close collaboration with experienced technical architects and executive leadership. 

How to Apply: Send your CV by E-Mail: jobs@iris-institut.de  

(Subject: Application – Software Engineer Applied AI & Geodata)
